lines.text: Alamo Injury Law, this is Boris, the firm's AI assistant. This call is recorded. How can I help?
Hey. My neighbor's dog got through their broken fence yesterday and bit my arm. Pretty bad.
I'm so sorry. Did you get medical care?
Yeah, the ER. Fourteen stitches. They said it might scar.
Animal Care Services came out. And the neighbor gave me their homeowner's insurance info.
Thank you. Do you know if the dog has bitten anyone before?
I think so. Another neighbor said it got loose last year.
An attorney will want to hear that. Can Nina Patel do a video call with you tomorrow at ten?
Booked. I'm texting you a summary and the video link now.
